title: Bug/648925 VAT charged in Sales Invoice with Cash Basis (Unrealized VAT) is not paid on Sales Credit Note applied to that Posted Sales Invoice if we use a similar Cash Basis VAT Prod Posting Group in the Mexican version - regression.
summary: Sales credit memos now correctly realize unrealized VAT from invoices when using equivalent but differently coded VAT posting groups in Cash Basis VAT mode, addressing a regression in the Mexican version.
key_points: Cash Basis VAT realization logic updated to identify equivalent VAT posting setups between invoices and credit memos
Equivalence determined by matching VAT business posting groups, calculation types, percentages, and account references
Supports full and partial credit memos with multiple VAT groups while preserving credit memo VAT posting groups in generated entries
Prevents unnecessary G/L entries and maintains existing public PostUnrealVATEntry interface
Automated tests added for full/partial credits, multiple VAT groups, and non-equivalent configurations
quote: Updated the Cash Basis VAT realization logic to identify equivalent VAT posting setups between sales invoices and sales credit memos.
